_about: The Tidebreak crowd (RingCrowd, shaders/ring/ring_crowd.gdshader; round 4 SHOW: fuller, lit, reacting fans instead of flat cut-outs). Built in code, seeded (the same crowd on every load), one MultiMesh per pose and a lighter mesh of each pose for a far view (visibility ranges: never both drawn).
_base_tris: round 3's crowd (3 poses, 862 fans; tools/ring/crowd_shots.gd at 0c19496): the budget is 2.5x it

light._about: Lit like the world, not cel: lambert with wrap, a sky and deck ambient by the mood, an occlusion term (laps, under the arms, the seat), the awnings' shadows and the lanterns at night through the engine's own lights; no outline.

react._about: set_cheer and react(kind, side, strength) (RingDressing.react: the stands' sound follows the same moments). launch: an ooh (heads up, a lean forward) at launch_mps or more, ooh_s long; fall: the stands rise in a ripple outward from the fall's end (ripple_mps), rising rise_s, standing hold_s, sitting back over sit_s, the far end reach_m off rising least; last_life and sudden: stand_share of the fans stand (stand_s to rise); in sudden death they clap on the score's beat.
